sections.heading: What kukuri is
paragraphs: kukuri is a decentralized application built on a P2P foundation. A central authority that governs the entire network does not exist; it is structurally impossible.
Your account, profile, follows, and posts are not owned by any particular community node and are not lost when a node stops or changes.

sections.heading: Eligibility and adult material
paragraphs: kukuri may only be used by people who are 18 years of age or older. By starting to use kukuri, you represent that you are 18 or older.

Display of adult material is disabled by default. To display it, you must explicitly enable it yourself in the settings screen. Adult material is identified by labels self-declared by the person who posted it, and the absence of a label does not guarantee that a post is free of adult material.

sections.heading: Prohibited uses
paragraphs: Using kukuri for unlawful purposes, or creating, sharing, or distributing child sexual abuse / exploitation (CSAM / CSE) or other critical rights-violating content, is prohibited.

Infringing the rights of others (intellectual property, privacy, reputation, etc.), disrupting the network, community nodes, or relays, and using kukuri for malware, phishing, or other malicious purposes are prohibited.

sections.heading: Ownership of your content
paragraphs: Copyright and other rights in text, images, audio, video, models, attachments, and other content you post or share remain, as a rule, with you or the lawful rightsholder.
Sharing content through kukuri does not by itself transfer those rights to the developers, the default community node, or any other Community Node.

sections.heading: Your rights and permissions
paragraphs: You represent that you own the necessary rights in any work, likeness, name, audio, video, 3D model, attachment, or other content you post or share, or have permission from the lawful rightsholder for the sharing and technical processing described here.
When quoting, reposting, editing, or combining third-party content, you are responsible for complying with applicable law and license terms.

sections.heading: Limited technical license
paragraphs: To make communication, display, and synchronization work within the audience you select, you grant the kukuri client and receiving peers in that audience a non-exclusive, royalty-free license only to receive, copy, store locally, display, and synchronize the content. This is not a transfer of ownership.

A public-topic post is shared with peers that obtain that topic. Private channels and DMs are limited to their designated recipients and may not be repurposed for a public topic or an unrestricted audience.

Docs handle text and metadata, and blobs handle attachments, within the selected audience. Hints only announce updates and do not expand the audience or license. Connectivity features only assist connections and do not grant rights to use content for another purpose.
Any license to a Community Node is limited by that node's per-node terms, capabilities that are actually enabled, authority scope, and content in which that node is involved.
No lasting or comprehensive network-wide rights are granted to disabled capabilities, uninvolved nodes, other nodes, the default node, or the kukuri project.

sections.heading: After withdrawal
paragraphs: A compatible client or node that recognizes a valid withdrawal by the user who posted it, or a node-local transmission block, stops future display, indexing, search, discovery, recommendation, synchronization, retrieval, caching, or delivery within its applicable scope. Records may be retained only where required by law and with their subject, purpose, and duration limited.

Copies already obtained by receiving peers or third-party nodes before withdrawal cannot be guaranteed to be remotely recovered or erased. Withdrawal does not mean immediate, complete deletion from the entire network.

sections.heading: Uses not licensed
paragraphs: The limited license does not include the right to use content for advertising, promotion, generative-AI training, machine-learning model training, or another independent secondary purpose.
It does not permit bypassing private-channel or DM access controls, expanding the selected audience, or repurposing content for a different public use.

sections.heading: Disclaimer for developers and node operators
paragraphs: The kukuri developers provide software that runs on a P2P foundation and are not responsible for the network as a whole, other users, or the activities of any community node.
A community node operator is responsible only within the scope of the support features that operator actually participated in, and not for the kukuri network as a whole or other nodes.
kukuri is provided as-is, and to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, no liability is accepted for any damages arising from its use or inability to use.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: These terms may be updated. When there is a significant update, the app re-displays the updated terms and asks you to accept them again.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.changeSummary: Version 4 identifies the controller and documents actual data flows, external transmissions, diagnostics, and P2P deletion limits.

sections.heading: Controller and basic approach
paragraphs: The controller is {{controllerName}} and the contact address is {{contact}}. The operator's name and address will be provided without delay when requested through that address.

Some information, such as your account-identifying secret key, settings, and consent records, remains local. Profiles, public follows, posts, reactions, and attachments are replicated to P2P participants according to the audience you select.

sections.heading: Information shared over P2P
paragraphs: Public profiles, public follows, public posts, replies, reposts, reactions, and attachments are replicated to peers that obtain the relevant user's profile replica or topic.

Private channels are limited to participants holding the capability, and DMs are limited to the designated peer. You cannot completely erase a copy already obtained by another participant from your device alone.

sections.heading: Connectivity and Community Nodes
paragraphs: Public keys, endpoint identifiers, IP addresses, and connection metadata can be observed by the Mainline DHT, peers, configured Community Nodes, iroh relays, and network providers. Routes are selected in the order Direct P2P, Relay Supported P2P, and Relay Fallback.

Depending on the capabilities you accept, a Community Node may receive authentication proofs, endpoint data, topic rendezvous keys, search queries, indexing requests, and report or feedback fields. A Node operator is not necessarily the kukuri operator; use the Node manifest to review its retention and external-transmission documents.

sections.heading: Automatic update checks and diagnostic reports
paragraphs: After consent, the app checks GitHub Releases automatically at startup and every 30 minutes, and when you request a check. GitHub and network providers can observe your IP address and HTTP/TLS request metadata.

A diagnostic report can include app version, platform/user agent, connectivity state, peer and topic counts, and Node URL/session/error information. Copying or exporting does not send it automatically. Secret keys, auth tokens, private capabilities, invitations, DM bodies, and local database paths are excluded by default.

sections.heading: Age attestation, analytics, and deletion limits
paragraphs: Your statement that you are 18 or older is stored locally as a self-attestation. kukuri does not collect your date of birth or official ID and does not perform official age verification. The current app does not enable behavioral analytics, advertising tracking, or automatic crash-report uploads by default.
Local deletion or withdrawal cannot guarantee complete deletion of copies or caches already held by peers or third-party Nodes, or logs held by the DHT, relays, or network providers.

sections.heading: Consent and change history
paragraphs: The app asks you to accept the terms and this policy before starting network connections. A material update increments the document version and requires renewed consent before networking resumes. Version 4 adds the controller, actual data flows, external transmissions, diagnostics, and deletion limits.
